{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {missing_body_mass}')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = df_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f'Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}')"}
